description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Flow field style. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. 4-color palette (#160B0B, #C2402A, #F49D37, #FFE8C2). Features: film grain. A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
